cohort: The study included 116 primigravida women with a singleton, term (37-41 weeks gestation), cephalic presentation pregnancy, and a Bishop score of <=6.
finding: Oral mifepristone significantly improved Bishop score, decreased induction to delivery time, and reduced the cesarean delivery rate compared to placebo, with consistent birth outcomes and no neonatal mortality.
mod_finding: The cesarean delivery rate was significantly lower in the mifepristone group (27.59%) compared to the placebo group (44.83%).
